title: MERGER DECISION NO 13: 2026
text:
MERGER DECISION NO 13: 2026
Notice in Terms of Section 53(4) (a)(ii) of the Competition Act 2018
DECISION ON THE ASSESSMENT OF THE PROPOSED PURCHASE AND SALE
OF TRIBAL GRANT NO. 8 LM LOCATED IN THE KGALAGADI TRIBAL AREA
FROM, BUCKSHOT (PTY) LTD BY THE NEW GROUP (PTY) LTD
Introduction of the Merging Parties
Pursuant to section 53(4)(a)(ii) of the Competition Act 2018 (“the Act”), notice is hereby
given on the decision made by the Competition and Consumer Authority (“the Authority”)
in relation to the proposed purchase and sale of Tribal Grant No. 8 LM located in the
Kgalagadi Tribal Area (“Target Property” or “Target Enterprise”), from Buckshot (Pty) Ltd
[“Buckshot” or “Seller”] by The New Group (Pty) Ltd [“The New Group” or “Acquiring
Enterprise”].
The Acquiring Enterprise, The New Group, is a company incorporated in accordance with
the Laws of Botswana. The Target Enterprise is currently owned and controlled by
Buckshot (the Seller), a company incorporated in accordance with the Laws of Botswana.
Merging Parties
The Acquiring Enterprise is a newly established and incorporated company and is not yet
operational. On the hand, the Seller was previously engaged in cattle and game farming
at the Target Property in Kang. The Target Property is currently operated solely as a
game farm.
In light of the above, the Proposed Transaction does not give rise to any horizontal overlap
in the activities of the Merging Parties. Furthermore, the Acquiring Enterprise is
considered a new entrant in the market in which the Target Enterprise operates.
Consequently, the proposed merger is not expected to alter the relevant market post-
implementation, as the status quo will be maintained. Therefore, there are no competition
concerns to arise as a result of the proposed transaction.
1

Merger Decision
Competitive Analysis and Public Interest
The Authority has established that the Proposed Transaction is not likely to result in a
substantial lessening of competition, nor endanger the continuity of service in the market
relevant in Botswana. Furthermore, the proposed merger will not have any negative effect
on public interest matters in Botswana as per the provisions of section 52(2) of the
Competition Act 2018.
The Determination
Pursuant to the provision of Section 53 of the Competition Act, 2018, the Authority has
decided to unconditionally approve the proposed purchase and sale of Tribal Grant No.
8 LM located in the Kgalagadi Tribal Area, from Buckshot (Pty) Ltd by The New Group
(Pty) Ltd.
However, as stated under section 61 of the Act, this approval does not override or negate
any other mandatory statutory approvals or processes that any of the parties to this
merger must comply with under the Laws of Botswana.
Dated at Gaborone on this 26th day of March 2026.
